mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects (workspace_id, key, name, template_id, status, visibility, workflow_id, active_tabs, start_date, end_date, description, created_by) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{key}, #{name}, #{templateId}, #{status}, #{visibility}, #{workflowId}, #{activeTabs, typeHandler=com.therecommerce.workmap.common.mybatis.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{description}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE key = #{key})
mapper.update:
UPDATE projects
name = #{p.name},
active_tabs = #{p.activeTabs, typeHandler=com.therecommerce.workmap.common.mybatis.StringListJsonTypeHandler},
default_tab = #{p.defaultTab}, start_date = #{p.startDate}, end_date = #{p.endDate}, description = #{p.description}, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE projects SET visibility = #{visibility}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE projects SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE wi.id IS NOT NULL) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE wi.common_status = 'DONE') AS done, count(*) FILTER (WHERE wi.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND wi.common_status NOT IN ('DONE', 'HOLD')) AS delayed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE wi.common_status = 'BLOCKED') AS blocked FROM work_items wi WHERE wi.project_id = #{projectId} AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL
